scope: Independent source, contract-to-test, build binding and experiment review of first H7-only within-observation coefficient reuse candidate. No proof acceptance is substituted for separate A0/A1 reviews; no default/mainline promotion.

findings.finding: Source diff is restricted to explicit H7 ABI rejection and local eight-entry decay/one arrays. The positive/negative active index, argument grouping, all 64 chronological state updates, response projection and invalid-observation predicate are preserved. No persistent cache, rate freezing, truth input or posterior reuse is introduced.

A0 graph is expressly a design-only dependency map. Validator checks ordered dependencies, cache-key transitive leaf completeness and all 78 pairwise dependency unions; mutation tests reject omitted mixed dependency, temperature key and non-topological order. This does not implement or qualify a continuous-shape coefficient representation, runtime executive or cache.

A1 premises map to standalone row/state tests, joint field QR/features, fused native contexts/readouts, invalid valid-prefix mutation and untouched suffix, empty calls, signed zero/rest and instrumented counts. Backend experiment compares contexts, field/live states, factors, messages, pending buffers, ownership/status and noise normalizers at every matched boundary.

Independent validation passes 99 registered source, copied source and binary identity checks; all four result files equal their summary entries. Registration binds 42 source files at the recorded revision, including dynamically imported runner/build/test modules. Candidate native copied kernels match registered unchanged sources.

Timing uses uninstrumented libraries with identical inputs and initial-state restoration outside timing, nine alternating response trials. Backend timing is a single alternating paired stream including refresh and failure work, correctly marked exploratory. Counter binaries are separate and cannot establish target cycles.

Failure witness preserves original observation digest 97ba065cb9e563cbefd43373e7ce7c03755b1696efa378bb65dad73ae82e667f; both arms fail and quarantine at 35,520 consumed/35,504 published records, with unchanged round-limit recovery failure. Candidate is not a repair.

resource_and_claim_limits: Bitwise claim remains conditional on nonaliasing immutable inputs, finite defined returned arithmetic, one synchronous owner, fixed binary64 arithmetic and deterministic libm. errno, floating flags/traps and asynchronous faults are excluded. Tests are finite witnesses, not full program verification.

Observed compiler is GCC 16.2.1 20260810 with O2, no-fast-math and fp-contract=off; macro receipt reports binary64 mantissa 53 and FLT_EVAL_METHOD 0. No cross-compiler, alternate rounding-mode or alternate libm qualification.

432-byte response and 272-byte ft_step are individual host compiler frames. They exclude nested library/caller stacks and are not complete peak call-chain or target SRAM measurements. Added 128-byte source payload need not increase reported frame size.
Response speedup is host process CPU on the registered workload; single-pass complete-backend figures are exploratory and not worst-case target timing.
Existing H7 50,624-byte packed factor alone exceeds approximately 10-KiB subsystem target; field buffers, projection, QR, prior, Python and other workspace remain. No M23-ready claim.
No persistent cache, graph executive, arena/lifetime allocator, continuous-shape compression, query certificate, physical coverage, aging or lifetime qualification is implemented by this change.
Adversarial graph tests validate internal declared-map consistency and cannot establish physical premises or correctness of a future graph scheduler.
recommendation: Accept the isolated candidate and its bounded host evidence, contingent on separately accepted current A1 proof review. Preserve current default/mainline and all original failure and approximation limitations. Future target builds, persistent reuse or representation changes require new independent review.
